inputs.prompt: A man is fast asleep in bed at night. He breathes slowly and evenly: his chest and the duvet rise and fall gently, and that is the only movement. His eyes stay closed and his face stays peaceful and still. The lamp glows steadily. The phone lying on the bedside table stays dark and still. The camera pushes in toward him extremely slowly and smoothly. Quiet night, soft room tone. One continuous shot with no cuts, no music, no speech, no subtitles and no text.
